boosting.note: Post-holdout check on the headline inputs. Test columns are descriptive only.

conformal.method: split conformal on |log1p(fee) - prediction| from the expanding CV folds' validation cycles; interval = expm1(prediction -/+ q), lower bound clamped at zero

definitions.europe_minutes: minutes in CL, EL, UCOL inside the lookback date window
definitions.lookback_date_window: [first match of the earlier completed lookback season, D)
definitions.other_league_goals: goals in those leagues inside the same window
definitions.other_league_minutes: minutes in first-tier domestic leagues other than the study league inside the lookback date window
definitions.team_points_per_game: mean league points the player's club took in the lookback PL matches he played

context_round.note: Second post-holdout round, designed after both the headline and the first follow-up had been scored. Variant selection used training-window CV only; test columns for non-selected variants are descriptive only.

market_value_comparator.note: Comparator only. Transfermarkt market value is never a model input. It is an expert estimate that may already reflect transfer rumours, so it is not a ceiling and beating or losing to it proves neither leakage nor purity.
market_value_comparator.rule: latest valuation with valuation_date < transfer_date and at most 365 days old

note: Follow-up designed after the headline holdout was scored. Not a headline result. Variant and model selection used training-window CV only.

price_level.definition: log of the median positive fee of moves where the buying or selling club played in the PL in the move's cycle season, over [D - window_days, D)

window_diagnostic.definition: in_season: a league season was in progress at the transfer date, so the lookback includes a partial ongoing season on top of two completed ones
